approval.requires: Explicit user approval of this revised one-shot authorization, the fixed frozen source commit, exact test command, and isolated dependency bootstrap

source.execution_checkout: Detached HEAD at frozen_commit; never execute from moving branch tip
source.execution_gate: A push that updates the authorization file with a commit message containing the exact authorization_id triggers this workflow once; all other pushes are skipped.

protocol.retry_policy: No automatic retries. Any failure or interruption stops the run; another attempt requires a new authorization.

dependencies.policy: Only these two runtime dependencies may be installed, in an isolated venv under RUNNER_TEMP, never in the repository checkout or system Python.
dependencies.runtime_bootstrap: actions/setup-python provisions CPython 3.12.3. Its runner-local pip bootstrap is permitted; test dependencies remain isolated in the temporary venv.

preflight_stop_conditions: Frozen commit or any of the nine listed Git blob identities mismatch
Wheel unavailable for either exact pinned dependency
Dependency version differs from the exact pin after isolated installation
Checkout is not clean before evidence and venv directories are created
Command differs from the exact command recorded here
Any request to expand scope beyond the four listed test modules
evidence_outputs: Frozen commit SHA and verified nine Git blob SHAs
Exact installed dependency versions and pip freeze
Workflow run URL and run ID
scientific_boundary: A PASS establishes only that the four listed software test modules pass for this frozen source snapshot and recorded runtime/dependency environment. It does not establish exhaustive mathematical correctness, uncertainty-aware certification, inferential validity, causal contribution, or scientific closure.

previous_attempt.disposition: Reviewed and corrected in protocol 002; new authorization required
